entities.name: Stalinism & Slovak Industrialisation
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Expulsion of ethnic Hungarians and Germans, Stalinist purges (Vladimír Clementis executed, Gustav Husák imprisoned), massive industrialisation transforming Slovakia from an agricultural to an industrial economy, and the Slovak quest for autonomy.
